item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia launched missile and cluster warhead attacks on Kyiv hours after agreeing to resume peace talks, killing at least nine civilians and injuring 57, while also striking other parts of Ukraine. Ukrainian forces disclosed a new cruise missile named Filin and reported infiltration of Russian rear areas through gas pipelines near Kupiansk and Khartiia. Ukraine announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones but noted critical capability gaps remain. Hackers linked to Russia employed a decentralised network in a cyberattack against Ukrainian targets. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
